identity.real_world_identity_notes: REITER technical data identifies the Murcielago R-GT with a Hollinger M6S six-speed sequential gearbox and racing clutch. AMS2 presents it in GT1_05 and visibly models a sequential lever without paddles.

wheel_rim.notes: Corrected AMS2 inspection and the independently fingerprinted RSS cockpit both show a D-shaped rim with an integrated display and shift lights. No reviewed real-car source establishes that equipment, so authentic display and shift lights remain unknown.
